name: clicky
description: Multi-agent penetration testing framework: orchestrates specialized agents through recon, exploitation, privilege escalation, and looting using attack-priority logic that self-calibrates from the operator's own accumulated session history, with an honest heuristic fallback until enough data exists.

default_password_wordlist.title: Default password wordlist
default_password_wordlist.description: Used by credential-attack skills (hydra/hashcat) when no engagement-specific list is supplied.

default_username_wordlist.title: Default username wordlist
default_username_wordlist.description: Used for spraying/enumeration when no engagement-specific list is supplied.

default_web_wordlist_dir.title: Default web content wordlist directory
default_web_wordlist_dir.description: Root of a SecLists-style wordlist collection used by the fuzzing skill for directory/vhost/parameter wordlists when no engagement-specific list is supplied. Distinct from default_password_wordlist/default_username_wordlist, which are hydra/hashcat credential lists, not web-content wordlists. Falls back to the plugin's small bundled wordlists in skills/fuzzing/assets/wordlists/ if unset.

max_parallel_operations.title: Max parallel operations
max_parallel_operations.description: Upper bound on concurrent service checks for /clicky:pentest-parallel.

require_confirmation_before_exploitation.title: Confirm before exploitation
require_confirmation_before_exploitation.description: Pause /clicky:pentest before moving from analysis into active exploitation. Not honored by /clicky:pentest-parallel, since workflows can't pause for mid-run input.

default_session_directory.title: Default session/output directory
default_session_directory.description: Base directory for session data, loot, and reports. Falls back to ~/.claude/sessions if unset.

scope_enforcement.title: Scope enforcement mode
scope_enforcement.description: Controls the strictness of the MCP gateway's (skills/mcp-gateway) scope check, run by register_target before a target is registered. 'enforce' (default): deny out-of-scope targets, ask about unlisted ones. 'warn': never blocks, just logs what it would have done to the session's logs/scope-enforcement.log. 'off': skips the scope check entirely. Any other value is treated as 'enforce'.

calibration_min_sample_size.title: Calibration minimum sample size
calibration_min_sample_size.description: Minimum recorded attempts a service/technique needs (across all your sessions, via skills/session-management/scripts/attempt-aggregator.sh) before skills/htb-decision-tree reports a measured success rate for it instead of the honest heuristic fallback. Lower values surface real data sooner but with wider statistical uncertainty.

tool_provisioning.title: Tool provisioning
tool_provisioning.description: 'none' (default): agents use whatever pentest tools (nmap, sqlmap, hydra, etc.) are already on your PATH, same as always. 'kalilix': agents get 33 real pentest tools from a reproducible Nix flake (github.com/scopecreep-zip/kalilix) with no manual installs. The toolchain is resolved lazily on the first command of an engagement and cached, so it never delays the gateway's startup. Requires Nix - run tools/clicky-setup.sh to set this up (it can install Nix for you, with confirmation, registers the Kalilix flake, and pre-warms the cache so your first command is fast; the wizard is a convenience, not a requirement). Falls back silently to 'none' behavior if Nix or the flake isn't actually available, so this is always safe to leave set even before running the setup wizard.
